title: Taking Care of Business
description: Brynjolf directs the player to the Ragged Flagon beneath Riften, then assigns them to collect overdue debts from three stubborn business owners: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand, and Haelga. Success earns membership in the Thieves Guild.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon beneath Riften.
I recruited the player after their performance in A Chance Arrangement.
Three business owners in Riften owe the Guild serious coin and refuse to pay: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand, and Haelga.

RECEIVE_DEBT_ASSIGNMENT: I have given the player the names of the three debtors and hinted at their weaknesses: Keerava cares for family, Bersi prizes his Dwemer urn, and Haelga is devoted to Dibella.
RETURN_TO_BRYNJOLF: The player has collected all three debts. I am impressed and ready to offer them a permanent place in the Guild.

base_facts: I run the Bee and Barb inn in Riften with my partner Talen-Jei.
I owe the Thieves Guild money but I have refused to pay them.
I have family at a farm just inside Morrowind that I worry about.

COLLECT_KEERAVA_DEBT: I have paid my debt to the Thieves Guild, whether through intimidation, a brawl, or fear for my family in Morrowind.

base_facts: I own the Pawned Prawn general store in Riften.
I owe the Thieves Guild money and I refuse to be extorted.
I have a priceless Dwemer urn displayed in my shop that I treasure greatly.

COLLECT_BERSI_DEBT: I have paid my debt to the Thieves Guild, either after a brawl or after my precious Dwemer urn was destroyed.

base_facts: I run Haelga's Bunkhouse in Riften.
I owe the Thieves Guild money but I will not be bullied.
I am a devoted follower of Dibella, the goddess of beauty.

COLLECT_HAELGA_DEBT: I have paid my debt to the Thieves Guild, whether through coercion involving my Dibella devotion, a brawl, or after hearing the others caved.

beats.comment: Player locates Brynjolf at the Ragged Flagon after traversing the Ratway.
Brynjolf assigns the player to collect debts from Keerava, Bersi, and Haelga.
Player collects Keerava's debt via brawl, intimidation about her family, or being the last debtor.
Player collects Bersi's debt via brawl or by smashing his Dwemer urn, or being the last debtor.
Player collects Haelga's debt via coercion about Dibella, brawl, or being the last debtor.
All three debts collected; player returns to Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon.
Quest finishes; player is welcomed into the Thieves Guild.
